title: Common
description: Shared enums and value types referenced by every other Attest schema. Spec: docs/Attest_MVP_Spec_v0.2.md Appendix A.

id.description: Opaque stable identifier. Task/criterion/transaction/checkpoint ids are ULIDs in practice; this schema does not enforce a specific format.

contentHash.description: Content-addressing hash used for criteria-set freezing (spec §5) and evidence artifacts (spec §6 evidence store).

assetPath.description: Project-relative path, forward slashes, always starting with Assets/ or Packages/.

taskStatus.description: Stage/outcome union — spec §9 stages 1-11 plus §9.4 stop conditions.

criterionResult.description: `unstable` means the same criterion disagreed across repeated runs of the same replay (spec §8) and must never be reported as `pass`.

actionSensitivity.description: Maps 1:1 to the approval policy table, spec §11.

moneyUsd.description: Decimal USD, not cents — precision beyond 4 decimal places is not meaningful at current model pricing.
